text: Good evening po. My apo is 10, a boy, temp is 38.2 just now. Earlier he bumped his head on the table corner. Umiyak agad, cried right away, then after a few minutes back to normal, playing his games, talking like always. Walang problema. I checked his neck, he can look down at his toes no problem. Skin and lips normal colour, hindi maputla. Also a few itchy insect bites on his legs, kinakamot niya. Just want to know if I should do anything more or just watch him tonight. Salamat.
